The '''2025 Women's EuroHockey Championship''' was the 17th edition of the [[Women's EuroHockey Championship]], the biennial international women's [[field hockey]] championship of [[Europe]] organised by the [[European Hockey Federation]].

The tournament was held alongside the [[2025 Men's EuroHockey Championship|men's tournament]] at the [[Warsteiner HockeyPark]] in [[Mönchengladbach]], Germany from 9 to 17 August 2025.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mönchengladbach to welcome 2025 EuroHockey Championships |url=https://eurohockey.org/monchengladbach-to-welcome-2025-eurohockey-championships |website=eurohockey.org |publisher=[[European Hockey Federation]] |access-date=8 March 2024 |date=8 March 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=EK hockey in 2025 opnieuw in Mönchengladbach |url=https://nieuws.nl/sport/20240308/ek-hockey-in-2025-opnieuw-in-monchengladbach/ |website=nieuws.nl |access-date=8 March 2024 |language=nl |date=8 March 2024}}</ref> It was the third time Mönchengladbach hosted the event.

The [[Netherlands women's national field hockey team|Netherlands]] were the four-time defending champions and won their 13th title with a win over Germany.<ref>{{cite web |title=Hockeysters voor vierde keer op rij Europees kampioen: winst op getergd België |url=https://nos.nl/collectie/13946/artikel/2488087-hockeysters-voor-vierde-keer-op-rij-europees-kampioen-winst-op-getergd-belgie |website=nos.nl |publisher=[[Nederlandse Omroep Stichting|NOS]] |access-date=5 December 2023 |language=nl |date=26 August 2023}}</ref> The winner would qualify for the [[2026 Women's FIH Hockey World Cup]] to be held in [[Wavre]], Belgium and [[Amstelveen]], Netherlands.<ref name="FIHWorldCup2026">{{cite web |title=Qualification System for 2026 FIH Hockey World Cups |url=https://www.fih.hockey/static-assets/pdf/qualification-system-for-2026-fih-hockey-world-cups-final.pdf |website=fih.ch |publisher=[[International Hockey Federation]]}}</ref> As the Netherlands won this tournament, Spain qualified.

==Qualification==
The top six team from the [[2023 Women's EuroHockey Championship|2023 edition]] have qualified directly for this edition of the tournament.<ref>{{cite web |title=Ireland's women and Spain's men preserve top level status for 2025 |url=https://eurohockey.org/irelands-women-and-spains-men-preserve-top-level-status-for-2025}}</ref> The last two teams will be the winners of the two sets of EuroHockey Qualifiers taking place in [[Glasgow]], Scotland and [[Douai]], France in August 2024.<ref>{{cite web |title=EURO B : les poules des qualificatifs |url=https://okey.lalibre.be/euro-b-les-poules-des-qualificatifs/ |website=okey.lalibre.be |access-date=28 September 2023 |language=fr |date=28 September 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=EuroHockey Qualifiers 2024 venues announced |url=https://eurohockey.org/eurohockey-qualifiers-2024 |access-date=28 September 2023}}</ref>
